description: Price one generate_video call WITHOUT spending credits: its credits (unit_credits per second of duration_s), its width and height, and warnings. Always call this first and show the user the price before generate_video. A reference is {upload_id, rights_confirmed: true} for a picture from upload_image or create_upload (rights_confirmed states you may use the people and works in it), {run_id} of a succeeded generate_image run of this account until its reusable_until, or {asset_id} of a picture asset from create_asset, whose rights were confirmed when it was made. A generation that fails is charged nothing. An identical request returns the same run it started before, so a call repeated after a lost answer starts nothing new; to make another one with the same request on purpose, pass attempt 2. While generations are closed it answers generations_disabled or generations_marking_pending and charges nothing.
